title: Team Wells Fargo Advisors and Merrill Lynch Supports The Jimmy Fund
description: Team members from Wells Fargo and Merrill Lynch  talk about the need for supporting The Jimmy Fund and the Connecticut Patient Assistance Project at Dana-Farber.  Cancer touches many people and it is especially tough when children are stricken.  Many Connecticut families choose to travel to Dana-Farber for treatments.

asr.full_text: My name is Barry Colano. I'm with Wells Fargo Advisors out of Boston. I made the trip down to Connecticut today to support my friend Anthony Ravosa. For hosting this second annual tournament here. I came down last year. It was a lot of fun. Got to meet a lot of nice, great people. And most importantly, support a great cause for the Jimmy Fund. And fighting cancer for Dana-Farber. I'm glad that I'm able to contribute to having a lot of fun and sharing this time,. But also being able to contribute to a great cause. Evan Gilchrist with Merrill Lynch, and really excited to be here. Obviously, during the work week, there's nothing better than playing a round of golf. And playing it for such a worthy cause. I would say my golf game is not worthy of such a worthy cause,. But really excited to be here and glad to be supporting it. Hi, I'm Rebecca Mendoza, and Evan and I both work for Merrill Lynch. Actually, our boss, Greg Costanza, and his friend, D.R. Dugan,. They were the ones that were supposed to play this golf tournament,. But, you know, they're getting up there and they're having some back problems,. So they sent the young kids in today. And but they felt that the cause is very important and so do we so we appreciate. Them sending us to give our support here.
